annotations.title: Link a GBP location to a project

description: Links (or repoints) a project to a Google Business Profile location. Take googleAccountId and googleLocationId verbatim from list_gbp_locations — both are Google's own resource names (e.g. "accounts/123", "locations/456"), not free text. Repointing replaces the existing link.

googleAccountId.description: Google account resource name, e.g. accounts/123.

googleLocationId.description: Google location resource name, e.g. locations/456.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: set_gbp_connection
